indicators.name: Indonesia 10Y govt bond yield
indicators.detail: Daily move down; +1.08pp over 1 year (Trading Economics). BRIDS shows 7.189% on 6 Oct.
indicators.source_title: Trading Economics - Indonesia 10Y government bond yield
indicators.why: The risk-free rate behind the discount rate in GoTo's valuation and in the cost of debt for its lending book.
indicators.evidence: User reference indicator; independent review pending

indicators.name: Retail sales growth (BI Real Sales Index, yoy)
indicators.detail: September 2026 is expected at +1.4% yoy (index 221.3), but expected -2.3% mom.
indicators.source_title: Bank Indonesia - Retail Sales Survey (News Release, 9 Oct 2026)
indicators.why: Weak low-single-digit retail growth caps the offline-to-online spending pool for Tokopedia, GoMart and GoPay merchants.
indicators.evidence: User reference indicator; independent review pending

indicators.name: Bank loan growth (yoy, OJK)
indicators.detail: Outstanding Rp9,178trn; deposit (DPK) growth 10.92%; gross NPL 2.11% (Dec-25: 2.05%), net NPL 0.84%. Prev value is Jun 2026 (Jul not found).
indicators.source_title: Bisnis.com - OJK: Kredit perbankan tumbuh 13,65% hingga Agustus 2026
indicators.why: Strong bank credit means competition for GoTo's lending, but also ready channelling and funding partners; rising NPLs show credit risk building.
indicators.evidence: User reference indicator; independent review pending

indicators.name: Pertalite (RON 90, subsidised) pump price
indicators.detail: Government says subsidised fuel prices stay unchanged through end-2026. Non-subsidised: Pertamax Rp15,950 (unchanged in Oct); Pertamax Turbo Rp19,600 (from Rp18,300) and Dexlite Rp23,700 (from Rp19,700), both from 1 Sep 2026.
indicators.source_title: Bisnis.com - Update harga BBM Pertamina, Shell cs per 9 Oktober 2026
indicators.why: Fuel is the main cost for Gojek driver-partners; a Pertalite hike would force fare or incentive adjustments.
indicators.evidence: User reference indicator; independent review pending

indicators.name: US Fed funds target (upper bound)
indicators.detail: Raised 25bp to 3.75-4.00% (12-0 vote); Sept minutes hawkish. First hike after cuts in Sep-Dec 2025.
indicators.source_title: BabyPips - Sept FOMC minutes support hawkish stance
indicators.why: Fed tightening widens rate differentials, pressures the rupiah, keeps BI hawkish and weighs on EM tech valuations.
indicators.evidence: User reference indicator; independent review pending

indicators.name: US 10Y Treasury yield
indicators.detail: Prev implied from -4bp move. Brent US$98.85/bbl the same day.
indicators.source_title: BRIDS Daily Economic & Fixed Income Update, 7 Oct 2026
indicators.why: Global discount-rate anchor; high UST yields pull capital from EM growth stocks like GOTO.
indicators.evidence: User reference indicator; independent review pending

indicators.name: Indonesia digital economy GMV (e-Conomy SEA 2025)
indicators.detail: 'Nearly US$100bn', +~14% yoy. E-commerce US$71bn (+14%+); transport & food US$10bn (+13%); digital payments GTV US$538bn. The 2024 base was not stated. The e-Conomy SEA 2026 report was not yet found (usually published Nov).
indicators.source_title: Google Blog ID - e-Conomy SEA 2025: Indonesia approaching US$100bn GMV
indicators.why: Sizes GoTo's addressable market: on-demand (US$10bn) is Gojek's core and e-commerce (US$71bn) underpins the Tokopedia stake's value.
indicators.evidence: User reference indicator; independent review pending

indicators.name: QRIS transaction volume growth (yoy)
indicators.detail: Total digital payments volume 6.11bn transactions (+40.36% yoy). Prev = Jul 2026.
indicators.source_title: Kontan - Pembayaran digital tumbuh 40,36% Agustus 2026, QRIS melesat 67,22%
indicators.why: QRIS is GoPay's key acceptance rail; fast growth expands volumes but makes payments interoperable and commoditised.
indicators.evidence: User reference indicator; independent review pending

indicators.name: P2P lending (pindar) outstanding
indicators.source_title: Pasardana - Naik 22% utang pinjol tembus Rp106,94 triliun
indicators.why: Benchmarks growth of GoTo Financial's consumer lending (GoPayLater/GoPay Pinjam) against the sector.
indicators.evidence: User reference indicator; independent review pending

indicators.name: P2P lending TWP90 (90+ day default)
indicators.detail: Prev = Jul 2026 (Bisnis.com). 16 platforms above the 5% threshold in Jul 2026.
indicators.why: Rising sector delinquencies signal consumer credit stress and possible tighter OJK oversight of GoTo's lending products.
indicators.evidence: User reference indicator; independent review pending

indicators.why: Multifinance (incl. BNPL/vehicle loans for drivers) is GoTo's lending competitor and partner; NPF trends show household leverage.

notes: BI-Rate decision date is 23 Sep 2026 (per sources), not 17 Sep. Next BI meeting 21 Oct 2026; next FOMC 27-28 Oct 2026 (not verified).

BI-Rate 2025 monthly path (cuts Jan, May, Jul, Aug, Sep 2025 to 4.75%; holds Oct-Dec) is from Bank Indonesia's decision record. Sources here confirm 150bp of cuts in the cycle to Sep 2025, the Sep 2025 cut (OCBC), the Dec 2025 hold at 4.75% (FocusEconomics), and 5.75% as the 'highest since Apr 2025' (Trading Economics). The 2026 path (4.75% Jan-Apr; +50bp May to 5.25%; +50bp Jun to 5.75%) is from Kontan/Bisnis/IDN Financials.
JCI prev close (6,094) and YTD (-31.4%) are derived: prev from the -2.59% move, YTD vs the 30 Dec 2025 close of 8,646.94 (Bisnis.com). The Jan-2026 high was ~8,936 (Republika).
USD/IDR series mixes Katadata spot snapshots; the 8 Oct Katadata title (17,916.4) conflicts with the 17,887.8 prev close cited on its 9 Oct page; the latter is used.
Credit growth prev (12.67%) is Jun 2026, not Jul 2026 (Jul not found).
UST 10Y prev (5.31%) is implied from a -4bp move.

Gaps (null): e-Conomy SEA 2026 not yet published (expected ~Nov 2026), so the 2025 report is used and the 2024 GMV base is unstated; multifinance prev/yoy and NPF prev not found; Aug 2026 unemployment not yet released; QRIS value (nominal) growth and user/merchant counts not found; no CPI monthly history for 2025.

Fuel: no Pertalite change found in 2026 (Rp10,000; government says it is unchanged through end-2026). Non-subsidised prices rose (Pertamax Turbo, Dexlite from 1 Sep 2026; BI cites non-subsidised fuel increases in Sep CPI). The Pertamax pre-2026 baseline was not verified.
CPI history sources: Kontan/Fortune (Jan 3.55, Feb 4.76, Mar 3.48), BPS (Apr 2.42, May 3.08), Trading Economics (Jun 3.34, Jul 2.88, Aug 3.19), BI (Sep 3.28).
P2P Jun 2026 outstanding (Rp105.14trn, +25.88% yoy) from MetroTV; Jul (Rp105.63trn, TWP90 4.32%) from Bisnis.com.

news.title: Bank Jago August statement review: extend monitoring beyond June
news.implication: Refresh the associate operating monitor using a newer financial period while keeping GoTo carrying values at their own reporting date.
news.nextAction: Compare with Q3 disclosures, review credit-quality ratios and reconcile deposit and loan definitions.

news.title: Bank Jago public expose adds direct lending and wealth strategy context
news.implication: Assess commercial synergies with GoTo separately from the associate equity interest.
news.nextAction: Monitor direct versus partner origination, funding mix and channel-level credit performance.

news.implication: Relevant to responsible-lending capability and consumer-risk monitoring in the financial ecosystem.
news.nextAction: Track usage, delinquency cohorts and any measurable change in credit outcomes.

feed.title: Grab denies rumours of exiting Indonesia after 8% cap

feed.title: Grab's stake in Superbank to rise above 50% with Emtek remaining controller

feed.title: Grab denies rumors of Indonesia exit after commission cap

cact.event: Grab plans to execute remaining approximately $900m buyback authority
cact.implication: Adds a relevant capital-return benchmark for GoTo's board. Compare repurchase value creation with liquidity needs, financing capacity and prospective deal returns.
cact.details: Grab intends to use remaining share-repurchase authority over the next 12 months, funded from existing cash. Execution depends on market conditions; the full amount is not guaranteed.

cact.event: Grab proposes $1.49bn acquisition of 60% of Atome Financial
cact.implication: A scaled BNPL and cash-lending competitor could increase pressure on GoPay's distribution and underwriting. Assess product overlap and partnership alternatives before assigning a financial impact.
cact.details: Grab signed for a controlling 60% stake, including $260m of primary capital. Closing is expected by Q3 2027, subject to approvals; it is not completed.

cact.event: Grab to deploy remaining ~$900M of buyback authorisation within 12 months
cact.details: Grab intends to use the remaining ~$900M of authorised repurchases over the next 12 months, taking cumulative buybacks since 2024 to ~$1.75B (>10% of Class A shares at current price); funded from $5.4B net cash liquidity (30 Jun 2026).
cact.implication: Signals Grab sees its own equity as cheap while still holding ample firepower for M&A; sets a capital-return benchmark GoTo investors will compare against GoTo's own buyback cadence.

cact.event: inDrive expands beyond ride-hailing into food, groceries, ads and fintech
cact.details: inDrive is putting most new investment into food and grocery delivery, scaling 'Ride Media' ads (25 markets, >2,000 advertisers/month) and inDrive.money (driver loans in LatAm +118% YoY in H1 2026); hired ex-Delivery Hero exec to lead food.
cact.implication: A low-cost ride-hailing challenger building a super-app playbook raises medium-term pressure on Gojek's GoFood and ads monetisation in price-sensitive segments.

cact.event: Akulaku confidentially files for Hong Kong IPO of up to US$500M
cact.details: Ant Group-backed Akulaku filed confidentially for a HK listing seeking US$300-500M; it was reportedly valued at ~US$2B in 2025 and had earlier considered a US listing.
cact.implication: A listed BNPL/digital-bank rival gains capital and a public valuation mark that will be read across to GoTo Financial (GoPayLater, Bank Jago); also signals HK as a viable venue for Indonesian fintech.

cact.event: Sea Q2 2026: revenue +48% to US$7.8B, Shopee GMV US$38.3B
cact.details: Revenue US$7.8B (+48.1%), net income US$458M, adj. EBITDA US$917M; Shopee GMV +28.4% to US$38.3B; Monee loan book US$11.1B (+62.5%, NPL90+ 1.0%); Garena bookings US$763.5M. CEO targets ~US$1B Shopee FY adj. EBITDA.
cact.implication: Shopee is out-growing the market while turning profitable, keeping pressure on Tokopedia (where GoTo retains an economic interest) and showing Monee scaling credit faster than GoTo Financial.

cact.event: Sea repurchases US$416.8M of shares in Q2 2026
cact.details: Under its US$1.0B programme, Sea bought back 4.7M shares for US$416.8M in Q2 2026; Garena deferred-revenue effect to be excluded from adj. EBITDA from Q3 2026.
cact.implication: Sea is now returning capital at scale, putting ASEAN internet peers (including GoTo) in a capital-return valuation framework.

cact.event: Uber Q2: scale, cash flow and investment gains require separate readings
cact.implication: Use as a global operating and capital-allocation benchmark; it is not a direct Indonesian mobility share measure.
cact.details: Uber reports $14.191bn revenue and $2.819bn adjusted EBITDA. GAAP net income includes a $1.6bn pre-tax equity-investment revaluation benefit.
cact.evidence: Primary source reviewed · Source publication date

cact.event: DoorDash Q2: delivery growth, membership and acquisition effects
cact.implication: A global delivery and merchant-software benchmark for GoFood, not an Indonesian competitive-share estimate.
cact.details: DoorDash reports 970m orders, $33.078bn Marketplace GOV and $914m adjusted EBITDA. Order growth excluding Deliveroo was 17%, versus 27% reported.
cact.evidence: Primary source reviewed · Source publication date

cact.event: Grab Q2 2026: record results, FY2026 guidance raised
cact.details: Revenue US$997M (+22%), adj. EBITDA US$168M (+54%, 16.9% margin), profit US$235M incl. US$307M Superbank remeasurement gain; FY2026 guidance raised to revenue US$4.10-4.15B and adj. EBITDA US$720-740M (from US$4.04-4.10B / US$700-720M).
cact.implication: Grab's widening margin and scale gap vs GoTo strengthens its position in any merger negotiation and its relative valuation.

cact.event: Grab authorises new US$750M share repurchase
cact.details: New US$750M authorisation brings cumulative buybacks to US$1.75B since 2024; the US$250M ASR and US$101M contingent forward purchase under the Feb 2026 programme were completed in July 2026.
cact.implication: Reinforces Grab's excess-cash position; a reference point for GoTo's capital allocation narrative.

cact.event: Blibli H1 2026: revenue +55%, net loss cut 43%
cact.details: Revenue Rp14.83T (+54.6% YoY); net loss attributable narrowed 43% to ~Rp708bn from Rp1.26T in H1 2025.
cact.implication: Djarum-backed Blibli is closing the profitability gap in e-commerce, raising the floor for Indonesian e-commerce competition and comps.

cact.event: 8% ride-hailing commission cap in effect from 1 July 2026
cact.details: Government confirmed app commissions capped at 8% (drivers keep 92%), down from up to 20%, effective 1 July 2026; implementing Perpres still being finalised across ministries.
cact.implication: Directly compresses Gojek and Grab two-wheeler take rates; levels the field with low-commission players (Maxim, inDrive) and reshapes the economics of a GoTo-Grab combination.

cact.event: Bank Jago H1 2026 net profit +49% to Rp189bn
cact.details: Net profit Rp189bn (+49%), loans Rp26.6T (+24%), gross NPL 0.8%, 20.1M customers; AGM approved no FY2025 dividend and board changes; partners incl. Bibit, Stockbit, BFI Finance.
cact.implication: GoTo's banking affiliate is scaling profitably, supporting GoTo Financial's lending and the value of GoTo's stake.

cact.event: Courting Express (TAXI) fleet after GoTo contract ends
cact.details: TAXI ended its GoTo fleet contract on 2 Jul 2026 and is exploring Green SM.
cact.implication: GoCar loses fleet supply; check other GoCar fleet partners for churn.

cact.event: Indonesian e-motorcycle launch and 2027 CKD plan at Subang
cact.details: Three models at Rp17.5-22m with battery subscription; V-Green 2,000+ swap points in Java; talks with ride-hailing operators.
cact.implication: Threat to Electrum and to GoTo control of the driver EV transition; also a possible fleet partner. Decide partner-or-compete before Grab does.

cact.event: Tokopedia trims e-commerce workforce again, following Shopee and Lazada
cact.details: Tokopedia (TikTok-controlled) cut more e-commerce staff after two rounds of layoffs the previous year; Shopee and Lazada also made cuts.
cact.implication: Continued consolidation of Tokopedia into TikTok Shop reduces GoTo's influence over the asset; a talent pool and cost-discipline benchmark.

cact.event: New e-commerce rules: 0.5% PPh 22 withholding, seller NIB, fee transparency
cact.details: From 1 Jul 2026 platforms withhold 0.5% tax on merchant turnover (PMK 37/2025); Permendag 19/2026 requires seller NIB, fee disclosure, anti-predatory pricing, local-product priority and import floor prices.
cact.implication: Raises compliance costs and may slow seller growth for Shopee and TikTok Shop/Tokopedia; reduces cross-border price pressure.

cact.event: Maxim cuts app commission to flat 8% from 1 July 2026
cact.details: Maxim Bike commission moved to a flat 8% (from 8-15%, ~12% average) under Perpres 27/2026; Maxim says rider fares will not rise.
cact.implication: Removes Maxim's commission-based driver recruitment edge; competition shifts to fares and incentives.

cact.event: Grab and Gojek adopt 8% two-wheeler commission under Perpres 27/2026
cact.details: Grab Indonesia (GrabBike) and Gojek (GoRide) to apply 8% commission from 1 July 2026, down from a 20% cap; President Prabowo announced Perpres 27/2026 on May Day 2026.
cact.implication: Hits Gojek and GrabBike revenue per trip equally; key input to Indonesian mobility forecasts and merger synergy cases.

cact.event: Kredivo's Krom Bank passes 1M accounts, Rp10T deposits
cact.details: Krom Bank (BBSI), controlled by Kredivo, passed 1M accounts and Rp10T deposits; Q1 2026 net profit Rp70.2bn (+98.6%) but impairment charges more than doubled to Rp455bn.
cact.implication: Kredivo is building a deposit-funded balance sheet to compete with GoPayLater/Bank Jago; rising impairments are a credit-cycle watchpoint.

cact.event: Grab takes control of Superbank, consolidates it
cact.details: Singtel transfers its Superbank shares to GXS Bank, lifting Grab's combined direct and indirect stake above 50%; Superbank consolidated into Grab Financial Services from May 2026.
cact.implication: Grab now controls a listed Indonesian digital bank, a direct rival to GoTo Financial and Bank Jago in deposits and lending.

cact.event: Sea Q1 2026: revenue +47% to US$7.1B, first US$1B adj. EBITDA quarter
cact.details: Revenue US$7.1B (+46.6%), net income US$438M, adj. EBITDA ~US$1B; Shopee GMV US$37.3B (+30.2%) but Shopee adj. EBITDA fell to US$223M on reinvestment; Monee revenue US$1.2B (+57.8%).
cact.implication: Shopee is reinvesting margin to take share, which means more promo intensity in Indonesian e-commerce.

cact.event: Krom Bank loans nearly double to Rp9.88T in Q1 2026
cact.details: Loans grew 98% YoY to Rp9.88T, with Kredivo and KrediFazz as main channelling partners; channelling is Krom's core 2026 lending strategy.
cact.implication: Faster-scaling bank-plus-BNPL model competes directly with GoTo Financial's consumer lending.

cact.event: Grab Q1 2026: revenue +24%, guidance reaffirmed
cact.details: Revenue US$955M (+24%), adj. EBITDA US$154M (+46%, 16.2% margin), profit US$120M; reaffirmed FY2026 guidance of US$4.04-4.10B revenue and US$700-720M adj. EBITDA.
cact.implication: Steady execution keeps Grab's valuation premium over GoTo intact.

cact.event: Blibli proposes non-preemptive issue of up to 9.5bn shares
cact.details: Up to 9.5bn new shares (6.92% of capital): 4.5bn for MESOP and 5bn for capital raising; EGM on 4 Jun 2026.
cact.implication: Fresh equity gives Blibli more competitive runway in e-commerce and retail.

cact.event: Grab launches US$250M ASR and up to US$150M contingent forward purchase
cact.details: US$250M accelerated share repurchase with JPMorgan (~54.9M shares initial delivery) and up to US$150M CFP with Morgan Stanley, under the US$500M Feb 2026 programme.
cact.implication: Aggressive buyback execution signals management sees undervaluation; it also reduces Grab's share count ahead of any stock-funded deal.

cact.event: Grab to acquire foodpanda Taiwan from Delivery Hero for US$600M
cact.details: US$600M cash, cash-free and debt-free; closing expected H2 2026, with migration to the Grab app by early 2027. Grab's first expansion outside Southeast Asia.
cact.implication: Shows Grab's appetite for large food-delivery M&A beyond ASEAN; reduces cash for, but does not preclude, an Indonesia deal.

cact.implication: A geographic expansion and execution benchmark; Taiwan is not an Indonesian market-share observation.

cact.event: Bukalapak FY2025 swings to Rp3.14T profit on investment gains
cact.details: Net profit Rp3.14T vs Rp1.54T loss in 2024; revenue Rp6.51T; net investment income of Rp2.37T was the main driver.
cact.implication: Bukalapak is now effectively a cash-rich investment vehicle with virtual-goods operations; a possible consolidation or acquisition target rather than a marketplace rival.

cact.event: Sea FY2025 net income more than triples to US$1.6B
cact.details: FY2025 revenue +36.3% to US$22.9B and net income ~US$1.6B.
cact.implication: Sea's profitability at scale widens the gap with GoTo and Tokopedia in e-commerce and fintech.

cact.event: DANA eyes IDX IPO, awaiting market timing
cact.details: DANA (Espay Debit Indonesia Koe) says an IPO is part of its long-term strategy and is studying the BUKA and GOTO IPOs; backers include Sinar Mas and Lazada, with Ant International as tech partner.
cact.implication: A listed DANA would give a public valuation peer for GoPay and could fund more aggressive wallet competition.

cact.event: Emtek unit buys 4.36% more of Bukalapak for Rp674bn
cact.details: Emtek subsidiary PT Kreatif Media Karya bought ~4.49bn BUKA shares (~4.36%) on 19-20 Feb 2026 for Rp674.3bn at Rp150, citing investment purposes.
cact.implication: Emtek creeping up its stake points to tighter control or a possible take-private; Emtek is also a key Superbank shareholder.

cact.event: Grab to acquire US investing app Stash at US$425M EV
cact.details: Grab is buying 100% of Stash Financial (EV US$425M): 50.1% at closing in cash and stock, the rest over three years. Stash has >US$5B AUM and >1M paying subscribers, with >US$60M adj. EBITDA expected in 2028. Closed July 2026.
cact.implication: Grab is expanding fintech internationally and using stock as currency; it shows Grab will pay for wealth and investing capabilities that GoTo has only through partners (Bibit, Stockbit).

cact.event: Grab FY2025: first full-year net profit; US$500M buyback
cact.details: FY2025 revenue US$3.37B (+20%), adj. EBITDA US$500M, net profit US$200M, adj. FCF US$290M; board authorised a US$500M buyback; targets US$1.5B adj. EBITDA by 2028.
cact.implication: Grab's 2028 target and its first full-year profit set a high bar for GoTo's profitability narrative.

cact.event: Grab entity raises direct Superbank stake to 11.10%
cact.details: A5-DB Holdings (Grab) bought 362.7M SUPA shares for IDR382.08bn (avg IDR1,053) on 14-19 Jan 2026, lifting its stake from 10.03% to 11.10%.
cact.implication: An early step in Grab's creep to control of Superbank, completed in May 2026.

cact.event: Superbank (SUPA) lists on IDX after ~US$167M IPO, oversubscribed ~318x
cact.details: IPO priced at Rp635/share; demand was ~318.7x oversubscribed with >1M orders; shares jumped 24.4% (limit-up) on debut.
cact.implication: Gives the Grab/Emtek/Singtel-backed digital bank a public currency and valuation mark against Bank Jago (ARTO); strong retail demand shows investor appetite for digital banks.

cact.event: Subang, West Java EV plant opens
cact.details: First Indonesian assembly plant; supports local-content (TKDN) rules for EV incentives.
cact.implication: Lower local price points for EVs that could be offered to GoRide and GoCar drivers.

cact.event: GoTo CEO Walujo to step down; seen as lifting Grab merger prospects
cact.details: DealStreetAsia reported Patrick Walujo would step down as GoTo CEO, with Patuwo likely to take over, after SoftBank, Peak XV and others reportedly sought the change.
cact.implication: A leadership change aligned with major shareholders could clear the way for a Grab combination; critical for corp-dev scenario planning.

cact.event: Sea announces up to US$1B share repurchase programme
cact.details: Board authorised repurchase of up to US$1B of ADSs, with timing depending on market conditions.
cact.implication: Sea's first major buyback in this cycle marks a shift to capital return and a rerating comparator for ASEAN tech.

cact.event: Indonesia reportedly backs GoTo-Grab merger; Danantara eyes golden share
cact.details: Reuters reported the government now fully backs a possible GoTo-Grab merger after initial opposition, with Danantara in talks for a golden share; the combined entity would hold >91% share (Euromonitor). Antitrust and driver-income conditions remain.
cact.implication: The most material strategic event for GoTo: a state-sanctioned path to combination with a likely golden-share veto and driver-welfare conditions.

cact.event: Grab Q3 2025 results; FY2025 guidance raised
cact.details: Revenue US$873M (+22%), adj. EBITDA US$136M (+51%); FY2025 guidance lifted to revenue up to US$3.4B and adj. EBITDA up to US$500M.
cact.implication: Continued upgrades strengthen Grab's hand and its relative valuation ahead of merger talks.

cact.event: Bukalapak launches further buyback of up to Rp420.79bn
cact.details: Up to Rp420.79bn from internal cash, running 24 Oct 2025 to 23 Jan 2026; the remainder of an earlier Rp1.13T programme.
cact.implication: Bukalapak keeps returning cash rather than reinvesting in commerce, confirming its retreat as an operating competitor.

cact.event: Grab makes equity investment in robotaxi firm May Mobility
cact.details: Grab took an undisclosed 'significant' stake in May Mobility to integrate its AVs into Grab's fleet, matching and routing systems, with Southeast Asia deployment from 2026.
cact.implication: Grab is building an autonomous-mobility moat; GoTo has no comparable AV partnerships.

cact.event: Tokopedia lays off 420 in second 2025 round
cact.details: 420 employees cut, bringing total layoffs since the January 2024 TikTok Shop merger to ~1,070.
cact.implication: Deepening integration under TikTok; GoTo's residual stake is increasingly passive.

cact.event: Grab commits strategic equity investment in WeRide
cact.details: Grab committed to an equity investment in WeRide (NASDAQ: WRD) to deploy L4 robotaxis and shuttles in Southeast Asia; completion expected by H1 2026.
cact.implication: Same as May Mobility: Grab is pulling ahead on the AV and long-term cost-structure narrative.

cact.event: Bukalapak extends buyback with Rp1.13T budget
cact.details: Bukalapak set aside up to Rp1.13T for a continued share buyback period (Jul-Oct 2025).
cact.implication: Large capital return from a cash-rich former rival; lowers BUKA float ahead of possible further Emtek consolidation.

cact.event: Grab prices upsized US$1.5B zero-coupon convertible notes due 2030
cact.details: Upsized from US$1.25B; 0% coupon, conversion price ~US$6.55 (40% premium); proceeds for general corporate purposes, strategic flexibility including acquisitions, and a concurrent ~US$273.5M buyback.
cact.implication: Explicitly builds an M&A war chest at the height of GoTo merger speculation.

cact.event: Grab reportedly targets GoTo acquisition at ~US$7B valuation
cact.details: Reports said Grab had hired advisers and held financing talks for a deal valuing GoTo at ~US$7B, with GoTo keeping Indonesian financial services; GoTo said no decision had been made.
cact.implication: Sets the reference valuation and structure (fintech carve-out) for any GoTo-Grab transaction.

cact.event: Emtek subsidiary buys 9.73bn Bukalapak shares
cact.details: An Emtek subsidiary acquired 9.73bn BUKA shares, increasing the group's control of Bukalapak.

ca.event: Scheduled EGM: cancel 32,186,417,803 treasury shares (capital reduction) and approve Catherine Hindra's resignation
ca.details: Record date 21 Sep 2026. Agenda: (1) capital reduction by retiring 32,186,417,803 Series A treasury shares bought 12 Jun 2024 - 11 Jun 2025 (~2.7% of shares) with amendment of Articles; (2) resignation of Deputy President Director. No quasi-reorganization/par value change found.

ca.event: GOTO falls 10% to Rp27; largest traded value on IDX; foreign net buy ~Rp134bn
ca.details: Close Rp27 (-10.0%); value Rp773bn, 28.1bn shares. IHSG -2.59% to 5,936. Foreign investors net bought ~Rp133-134bn of GOTO while net selling the market. Stock -46% in a month.

ca.event: Assessment: was the Sep-Oct 2026 drop caused by Morgan Stanley OTC buying of ESOP shares? - No evidence
ca.details: (1) No source identifies the sellers to Morgan Stanley; none mentions employees/ESOP/GoTo Peopleverse Fund. Timing (21 Aug-2 Sep, around MSCI exit, Rp152bn net foreign negotiated-market selling at avg IDR 24 on 1 Sep, BlackRock stake down) points to passive index funds exiting. (2) No new ESOP supply: GoTo cancelled the treasury-to-MESOP plan (Jul 2026); only recent ESOP sale found is Deputy CEO 516m at ~IDR 52 in Mar 2026; the "IDR 2" figure is the 2022 exercise price. (3) Main driver: removal of the IDR 50 floor on 28 Sep released pent-up selling; regular price fell 50->43->37->32->28 (25 Sep-1 Oct; auto-reject lower 29 Sep) and converged to the IDR 23-27 negotiated-market level. The OTC trades revealed the clearing price rather than caused the fall. (4) Morgan Stanley outright sales since 23 Sep (~1.4bn shares) are small vs daily volume; 7.4bn on 4 Sep was a repo. Gaps: IDX negotiated-market counterparties and KSEI data not obtained; two Morgan Stanley stake series (~7% vs ~5.4%) do not reconcile.

ca.event: Morgan Stanley sells 344.9m GOTO; stake 5.36% -> 5.33%
ca.details: Price not stated. A further ~70m-share sale was also reported (IDN Financials, date not captured). Combined outright sales since 23 Sep ~1.4bn shares vs ~13bn GOTO shares traded on 9 Oct alone.

ca.event: GoTo letter to IDX explains share-price volatility as technical
ca.details: Management attributes the fall to: FTSE exit (22 Jun), IDR 50 floor suppressing volume since May, MSCI exit (31 Aug) forcing passive selling that could not clear on the regular market, and the IDR 1 floor (28 Sep) letting queued sellers sell. Says it knows only of trades disclosed on IDX, is unaware of any majority-shareholder transactions (largest holder ~7%), and that the ESOP/MSOP plan for treasury shares was cancelled in favour of capital reduction. "Current share price does not reflect strengthening fundamentals."

ca.event: IDX lowers minimum price from IDR 50 to IDR 1; GOTO trades below IDR 50
ca.details: New IDX rule (applies to Special Monitoring Board/full call auction stocks per source; applicability path to GOTO not verified) effective ~28/29 Sep 2026 (source date inconsistent). GOTO traded ~IDR 37 on 28/29 Sep; Telkomsel's stake (1.99%, cost IDR 270/sh) down ~86%. GOTO top foreign net sell in early Oct 2026.

ca.event: Morgan Stanley sells 503.6m GOTO (disclosure); stake 5.40% -> 5.36%
ca.details: Per IDX >5% holder report dated 25 Sep; trade date and price not stated. Part of the ~5.4% reporting series (see 11 Sep FLAG).

ca.event: Morgan Stanley sells 450m GOTO at IDR 27
ca.details: Stake 7.0233% -> 6.9842% (80.8bn -> ~80.4bn shares). Executed before the IDR 1 minimum price took effect (28 Sep).

ca.event: Morgan Stanley buys 400m GOTO at IDR 27
ca.details: ~Rp10.8bn; stake 6.9951% -> 7.0299%. Disclosure lists Morgan Stanley & Co International Plc in an organised group with Morgan Stanley & Co LLC - Client Account. Purpose: investment.

ca.event: Morgan Stanley sells 1.39bn at IDR 29, buys 420m at IDR 28
ca.details: Net ~973m shares sold. Stake 7.059% -> 6.9745% (81.28bn -> 80.30bn shares). FLAG: IDN Financials reports a separate 997.9m sale on 11 Sep leaving 5.42% - a parallel ~5.4% series likely reflects a different Morgan Stanley reporting entity/account (filings do not reconcile).

ca.event: Morgan Stanley repo of 7.4bn GOTO shares at IDR 25-27 (not an outright sale)
ca.details: Repurchase agreement in negotiated market: 1.45bn at IDR 27 + 5.95bn at IDR 25 (~Rp187bn). Reported stake 7.38% -> 6.99%. Widely headlined as a sale, but Kiwoom (Liza Camelia Suryanata) notes it is a repo, holding is indirect/non-controlling and may include client/custodial positions; IDR 25 reflects bilateral pricing/collateral haircut, not a regular-market reference.

ca.event: Morgan Stanley buys ~21.9bn GOTO at IDR 25 (negotiated market); stake to 7.59%
ca.details: Three trades on 2 Sep: 12.57bn, ~200m and 9.22bn shares at IDR 25 (~Rp542-548bn), a 50% discount to the IDR 50 floor. Stake 5.71% -> 7.59% (87.48bn shares). Disclosed 7 Sep. Stated purpose: investment, "not aimed at control". Seller not disclosed.

ca.event: MSCI exit effective: GOTO largest net foreign sell, mostly in negotiated market at avg IDR 24
ca.details: First trading day after MSCI removal. Net foreign sell Rp152.5bn across all markets, of which Rp152.3bn in the negotiated market at an average IDR 24/share (Stockbit data). Kontan reports BlackRock stake fell sharply while Vanguard accumulated (figures paywalled). Consistent with passive index funds exiting via block trades because the regular market was pinned at IDR 50.

ca.event: Deputy President Director Catherine Hindra Sutjahyo resigns
ca.details: Resignation letter received 28 Aug 2026 (personal/family reasons); subject to EGM approval on 14 Oct 2026. No successor named.

ca.event: Morgan Stanley buys ~3.8bn GOTO at IDR 23 in negotiated market; crosses 5%
ca.details: Morgan Stanley & Co International Plc bought 3.13bn shares at IDR 23 plus ~657m via crossing (Rp87.3bn total), 54% below the IDR 50 regular-market floor. Stake 4.82% -> 5.15% (55.57bn -> 59.36bn shares). Stated purpose: investment. Ahead of MSCI Global Standard exit (effective 31 Aug). Seller not disclosed; no mention of employees/ESOP.

ca.event: MSCI removes GOTO from MSCI Indonesia (Global Standard) index, effective after close 31 Aug 2026
ca.details: Removal driven by illiquidity at IDR 50 floor; weight reduced to zero ahead of deadline. GOTO ~4% of MSCI Indonesia at end-July; estimated passive outflow ~IDR 1tn (Mirae). GoTo called it 'purely technical'.

ca.event: Management calls a reverse stock split 'one possible option'; still evaluating
ca.details: On the Q2 2026 call, management called a reverse split 'one possible option' to address the share price but said it is not straightforward in Indonesia, has few precedents and is viewed negatively by the public. Options are still being evaluated. Bisnis (31 Jul 2026) reported GoTo weighing the risks of a reverse split to lift the stock from the IDR 50 floor. No proposal, ratio or EGM agenda found. The 14 Oct 2026 EGM agenda covers only the capital reduction and the director resignation.

ca.event: GoTo cancels treasury-to-MESOP plan; to pursue capital reduction instead
ca.details: Dropped plan to transfer ~32.19bn treasury shares (2024-25 buyback) to the employee/management stock ownership program approved June 2025; will instead cancel them via capital reduction (~2.7% of shares). Reviewing options for a further 7.59bn treasury shares bought 19 Jun 2025 - 18 Jun 2026.

ca.event: Bank Jago and BFI Finance deny merger rumour
ca.details: Reports of a Bank Jago (GoTo/GoPay associate, ~22% per Wikipedia) and BFI Finance merger; both denied, Bank Jago said no merger in its 2026 business plan. GoTo management on Q2 call said a merger was 'still not 100% certain'.

ca.event: 8% commission cap takes effect for 2-wheel ride-hailing; GoTo cuts ODS guidance, raises fintech
ca.details: GoTo applies the 8% platform commission (from ~20%) to 2W mobility from 1 Jul 2026 under Perpres 27/2026. FY26 adj. EBITDA guidance: ODS cut to Rp1.4-1.5tn (from 1.7-1.8tn), fintech raised to Rp1.7-1.8tn (from 1.4-1.5tn), group held at Rp3.2-3.4tn. BRIDS estimates 2W = ~10% of ODS gross revenue; UOB KH cut ODS revenue by ~3%.
sources: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas, GOTO company update, 3 Jul 2026 (client-provided PDF)
UOB Kay Hian, Asian Gems Corporate Highlights, 28 Sep 2026 (client-provided PDF)

ca.event: Executives exercise ESOP shares
ca.details: Hans Patuwo exercised 188.18m ESOP shares (holding 763.01m); Deputy CEO Catherine Hindra Sutjahyo acquired 515.89m via ESOP and sold all on 16-17 Mar 2026 at ~IDR 52. Program administered via GoTo Peopleverse Fund. Exercise price not disclosed.

ca.event: Bloomberg: Grab-GoTo deal hits snag over Telkomsel's ~2% stake
ca.details: Telkomsel (state-linked; ~2% of GoTo, ~US$450m invested 2020-21) reportedly unwilling to sell near market price due to state-loss liability concerns; separate buyout structure for Telkomsel being discussed. GoTo mkt cap ~US$4.2bn vs Grab ~US$18.5bn; prior >US$7bn / ~IDR 100/share all-stock idea outdated after ~30% share drop. Draft ride-hailing decree (commission cap, insurance) also unresolved. Negotiations ongoing; no conclusion. This is the LATEST substantive public reporting on deal negotiations found (as of 2026-10-10).

ca.details: Nominated 24 Nov 2025. Patuwo (ex-COO) replaced Walujo (~2.5-year tenure). Co-founder Andre Soelistyo and Santoso Kartono appointed commissioners, replacing Pablo Malay and Winato Kartono; director Ade Mulyana resigned. GoTo stated the EGM was not related to any corporate action plan.

ca.event: KPPU chair warns it could cancel a GoTo-Grab merger
ca.details: KPPU Chair M. Fanshurullah Asa said the merger must comply with competition law and KPPU would not hesitate to cancel it if anti-competitive; warned GoTo, Grab and Danantara against bypassing KPPU.

ca.event: SoftBank, Provident, Peak XV push to replace CEO Patrick Walujo
ca.details: Bloomberg-reported: major backers pressing for CEO change, seen as smoothing path to Grab deal (Walujo had opposed a Grab takeover).

ca.event: Government signals support for Grab-GoTo combination; Danantara golden share discussed
ca.details: Palace spokesperson said government discussed a possible merger/acquisition (~7 Nov). Reuters (13 Nov) reported government now fully supports a deal after earlier opposition; Danantara in talks to take a 'golden share' (veto rights) in combined entity; Anthony Tan met President Prabowo. State Secretary Prasetyo Hadi linked the talks to drafting of the ride-hailing Presidential Regulation. GoTo (10-11 Nov) said no decision/agreement with Grab or Danantara. Danantara CIO Pandu Sjahrir: decision rests with companies.

ca.event: IDR 4.65tn (~US$280m) 4-year term loan from DBS Indonesia and UOB
ca.details: Mandated lead arrangers PT Bank DBS Indonesia and UOB. Proceeds partly to refinance Nov 2022 facility (IDR 467bn outstanding at Jun 2025); remainder for general corporate purposes incl. investments and working capital.

ca.event: DealStreetAsia: Grab-GoTo merger talks called off again
ca.details: Sources said talks had ended once again.

ca.event: AGM/EGM approves new US$200m (~IDR 3.3tn) buyback (19 Jun 2025 - 18 Jun 2026), treasury-to-MESOP transfer and board changes
ca.details: Proposed 13 May 2025. Approved buyback up to US$200m (~IDR 3.3tn), max 10% of capital, on/off exchange, funded by internal cash. Approved transfer of treasury shares (from 2024-25 buyback) to employee/management stock ownership program (later reversed, see 2026-07-28). Catherine Hindra Sutjahyo became Deputy CEO/Vice President Director replacing Thomas Husted; new directors incl. Monica Lynn Mulyanto (CPO), R.A. Koesoemohadiani (Legal/Corp Sec), Ade Mulyana, Wuzhen (William) Xiong (CTO), Sudhanshu Raheja (President, GoTo Financial). Execution: 7.59bn shares repurchased 19 Jun 2025 - 18 Jun 2026 (value not found - GAP).

ca.event: 2024-25 buyback concluded: 32.19bn shares, ~IDR 2.09tn (~US$130.8m)
ca.details: Cumulative 32,186,417,803 Series A shares (~2.99%) repurchased for ~US$130.83m / IDR 2.09tn vs. US$200m cap (implied ~IDR 65/share). Completion disclosed 16 Jun 2025. Shares held in treasury.

ca.event: Grab says it is not in talks with GoTo 'at this time'
ca.details: Grab statement: 'The parties are not involved in any discussions at this time and Grab has not entered into any definitive agreements.' Momentum stalled amid KPPU/regulatory concerns; Reuters (19 Jun 2025) reported government conditions (driver fees/bonuses, Indonesian majority ownership per DPR deputy speaker Dasco).

ca.event: Reuters: Grab aims to sign GoTo takeover in Q2 2025 (~US$7bn)
ca.details: Grab hired advisers and was in talks with banks for financing; structure reportedly: GoTo sells international unit and all Indonesian operations except its financial-services arm to Grab. GoTo (8 May and 16 May 2025 filings) said it had received confidential, non-binding, early-stage offers from several parties, no agreement or decision.

ca.event: Reports GoTo exploring sale/spin-off of GoTo Financial; Grab due diligence under way
ca.details: DealStreetAsia-sourced reports: GoTo in advanced talks to sell GoTo Financial (GoPay, GoPay Later) to a Japanese investor; Grab reportedly began due diligence on GoTo via a Big Four firm (4-6 months). No transaction confirmed (FLAG: unconfirmed).

ca.event: Reuters: Grab and GoTo in advanced merger talks
ca.details: Talks resumed Dec 2024; investors eager for a 2025 deal; combined value ~US$25bn. Both declined to comment; GoTo subsequently called reports speculation. Reports (Bloomberg, Feb 2025) cited Grab considering valuation >US$7bn, e.g. all-stock at ~IDR 100/share (later reporting also cited IDR 100-110).

ca.event: GoTo raises effective ownership of PT Multifinance Anak Bangsa from 96.03% to 99.99%
ca.details: GoTo's FY2025 consolidated financial statements show MAB's effective ownership up from 96.03% (2024) to 99.99% (2025) ('the Group added its ownership in the subsidiary'). The FY2025 cash flow statement shows IDR 45.6bn paid to acquire non-controlling interests, but it is not confirmed that this payment relates only to MAB. The FY2025 statements also list two new subsidiaries set up in 2025: Velox Cloud Holdings Pte. Ltd. (100%) and GoTo Times (Beijing) Technology Co., Ltd. (99.99%). Counterparty (presumably Winato Kartono's remaining ~3.96%) and price not found (FLAG).

ca.event: GoTo loses control of Kripto Maksima Koin (now FLOQ); remaining stake becomes an associate
ca.details: GoTo's effective stake in KMK fell from 99.99% (2023) to 67.96% during 2024. After GoTo divested an interest in a subsidiary in Oct 2024, KMK and its holding company Kripto Maksima Holding (KMH) were deconsolidated. The retained interest was remeasured at fair value and is now equity-accounted. KMK was rebranded FLOQ (grand launch 30 May 2025) under Timothy Ronald (Akademi Crypto), with ex-Tokocrypto CEO Yudhono Rawis involved. Buyer, price and GoTo's residual % were not disclosed or confirmed (FLAG). GoTo's Pablo Malay has been a KMH director since 2024.

ca.event: Gojek exits Vietnam (operations ceased 16 Sep 2024)
ca.details: GoTo announced exit from Vietnam to focus on Indonesia/Singapore and profitability; services terminated from 16 Sep 2024.

ca.category: Treasury share cancellation / capital reduction; C-suite
ca.event: EGM approves cancellation of 10.26bn treasury shares; Simon Ho appointed CFO
ca.details: Capital reduction via cancellation of 10.26bn Series A treasury shares (~0.85% of outstanding) originating from pre-IPO buybacks (2021) and the IPO greenshoe/stabilisation (2022). Post-cancellation ~1.19 trillion shares listed (~1.14tn Series A, ~50.57bn Series B per KB Valbury; source states 'billion', likely a typo). Jacky Lo resigned as director/CFO; Simon Tak Leung Ho (ex-Maya, FinVolution) appointed director and Group CFO.

ca.event: GoPay Later launched on TikTok's ShopTokopedia
ca.details: GoTo Financial's BNPL (credit limit up to IDR 10m; 1/3/6/12-month tenors) became available on ShopTokopedia (TikTok), extending the GoTo-TikTok partnership in which GoPay was already a payment method. (The quarterly GMV-based e-commerce service fee from Tokopedia, effective 1 Feb 2024, is already in the existing log.)

ca.event: AGM/EGM approves up to US$200m (~IDR 3.2tn) buyback (12 Jun 2024 - 11 Jun 2025)
ca.details: Shareholders approved market buyback of up to US$200m (~IDR 3.2-3.26tn) for 12 months, plus changes to board composition.

ca.category: Share class (Series B multiple voting shares)
ca.event: EGM approves CEO Patrick Walujo as an eligible holder of Series B multiple-voting shares
ca.details: Under POJK 22/2021, the EGM approved Patrick Walujo as a party that may hold Series B (MVS) shares. Management said this would not increase the number of Series B shares. GoTo no longer issues founder Series B shares, so any transfer would come from existing holders and converts to Series A unless made to an approved MVS holder. Series B carries ~30x votes (CNBC Indonesia). At listing, the founders plus PT Saham Anak Bangsa held 6.08% of shares and 58.26% of votes. Named Series B holders in 2024: William Tanuwijaya, Melissa Siska Juminto, Andre Soelistyo, Kevin Aluwi and PT Saham Anak Bangsa. Whether Walujo actually received Series B shares, and the Series B position after his Dec 2025 exit, were not found (GAP).

ca.event: First-phase buyback: 3.825bn shares (~IDR 198.4bn)
ca.details: Per June 2024 financial statements, GoTo repurchased 3,825,000,000 Series A shares for IDR 198.40bn (~0.32% of shares; implied ~IDR 52/share per CNBC estimate). Executed in June 2024 under the US$200m authorization (these shares are included in the 32.19bn cumulative total). FLAG: one source treats it as a separate pre-AGM phase.

ca.event: GoTo Logistics (PT Paket Anak Bangsa) divested
ca.details: GoTo sold 2.43m shares of PT Paket Anak Bangsa (parent of GoTo Logistics; subsidiaries PT Swift Shipment Solutions and PT Swift Logistics Solutions) to third parties for IDR 14.7bn, losing control. Rationale: internal restructuring after Tokopedia deconsolidation.

ca.category: M&A (minority buyout) / affiliated transaction - GoTo Financial multifinance
ca.event: GoTo (via PT Mapan Global Tech) buys 11.04% of PT Multifinance Anak Bangsa (GoPayLater) from commissioner Winato Kartono
ca.details: PT Mapan Global Tech (Findaya; >=99% GoTo) bought 309.12m MAB shares (11.04%) from Winato Kartono, a GoTo commissioner (appointed Mar 2023) and Provident co-founder, for IDR 32,452,859,608 (nominal value IDR 30.91bn); deed signed 1 Apr 2024. GoTo's ownership (previously 85% via PT Gofin Karya Anak Bangsa) rose to ~96.04% (DealStreetAsia says 96.4%). GoTo also planned to inject IDR 678.72bn of IPO proceeds into MAB (not yet disbursed as of the Jan 2024 use-of-proceeds report). How MAB was originally acquired or set up was not found (GAP).

ca.event: Bloomberg reports Grab and GoTo revived merger talks
ca.details: Bloomberg (Fri 9 Feb 2024) reported preliminary revival of ride-hailing merger talks. GoTo denied on Tue 13 Feb 2024 that it was in any discussion, citing positive adjusted EBITDA in Q4 2023.

ca.event: TikTok completes Tokopedia investment
ca.details: Tokopedia issued ~38.19m new shares (75.01%) to TikTok for US$840m; TikTok also provided a US$1bn promissory note to Tokopedia (working capital) and acquired ~US$340m of Tokopedia business assets/contracts. Purchase price IDR 747.87/share vs. pre-deal valuation of 100% of Tokopedia at US$606m (IDR 9.4tn). GoTo deconsolidated Tokopedia, retaining 24.99%, and booked ~IDR 80.3tn non-cash goodwill impairment/loss. GoTo receives quarterly e-commerce service fees based on a sliding percentage of Tokopedia GMV. Put/call option terms NOT found in sources reviewed (GAP). No evidence found of a later sale of GoTo's remaining 24.99%.

ca.event: TikTok to acquire 75.01% of Tokopedia; GoTo retains 24.99%
ca.details: Announced 11 Dec 2023. TikTok to take 75.01% controlling stake in PT Tokopedia (merged with TikTok Shop Indonesia) and commit >US$1.5bn of long-term funding. GoTo keeps 24.99%, stated at the time to be non-dilutive going forward. GOTO shares fell sharply on announcement.

ca.event: GoTo subsidiary PT Rekan Anak Bangsa grants Electrum a loan facility of up to IDR 45bn
ca.details: RAB lends EKB (Electrum) up to IDR 45bn at 10.95% p.a. on the unpaid principal, repayable in full within 5 years of the facility agreement, for opex and capex (including subsidiaries' capex via equity injections). At the time RAB and PT Karya Baru TBS each held 78,500 EKB shares (50/50). Drawn amount not found (GAP).

ca.event: IDX denies circulating notice that GOTO would do a reverse stock split
ca.details: A fake notice dated 7 Nov 2023 claimed a GOTO reverse split to IDR 450 par. IDX Director Irvan Susandy called it untrue (unsigned by the named IDX officials).

ca.event: GoPay and Bank Jago launch 'GoPay Tabungan by Jago' bank account
ca.details: A Bank Jago savings/transaction account inside the GoPay and Gojek apps: GoPay balance converts in ~2 minutes, 2.5% p.a. interest, no monthly fee or minimum balance, LPS-insured. Announced by Hans Patuwo (then President, Fintech). Commercial partnership with a ~21.4% associate.

ca.event: US$150m IFC/Franke package: 17.05bn new shares to Bhinneka Holdings, US$50m notes, and US$150m exchangeable bonds (EXPLAINS FY2023 'equity-linked bond proceeds')
ca.details: Structure: (1) GoTo issued 17,045,733,334 new Series A shares (~1.42%) at IDR 90 (~IDR 1.53tn / ~US$100m) to Bhinneka Holdings (22) Limited (BHL, Cayman), using the June 2023 PMTHMETD authority. (2) GoTo International Finance (22) Limited (100% GoTo) issued US$50m notes to BHL, guaranteed by GOTO (Notes Subscription Agreement 2 Oct 2023; Citibank N.A. Hong Kong custodian). (3) BHL funded both by issuing US$150m equity-linked bonds: IFC US$125m, WAF Investments Cayman LLC (Franke & Co) US$25m. Terms: 5% coupon paid semi-annually, maturity Oct 2028, exchangeable into the GOTO Series A shares held by BHL at IDR 135/share (50% premium to the 1-month VWAP to 2 Oct 2023). Placing agents: Citigroup Global Markets and Goldman Sachs (Singapore). Total ~IDR 2.3tn. Placement proceeds: 25% GoTo, 15% each to Tokopedia, Swift Logistic Solutions, Dompet Anak Bangsa, Multifinance Anak Bangsa and GoTo Solusi Niaga (sources disagree slightly on the list). GoTo's FY2025 accounts consolidate BHL as an entity with no effective ownership (total assets IDR 2.92tn at end-2025). This is very likely why the bonds appear as 'equity-linked bond proceeds' (~IDR 2.3tn) in GoTo's FY2023 cash flow statement. That link is our inference, not stated in a source read (FLAG). IFC also to support fleet EV transition. Outstanding/exchanged amounts as of 2026 not found (GAP).
ca.status: completed; bonds outstanding to Oct 2028 (exchange status unknown)

ca.event: GoPlay sold to Edy Sulistyo
ca.details: GoTo sold entertainment/streaming unit GoPlay to Edy Sulistyo (founder/ex-CEO of Loket.com); value undisclosed.

ca.event: 2023 AGM/EGM: Patrick Walujo becomes CEO; Andre Soelistyo moves to Board of Commissioners
ca.details: Announced 8 June 2023. Andre Soelistyo (President Director & Group CEO) moved to Deputy Chairman of the Board of Commissioners; Patrick Walujo (Northstar co-founder) nominated President Director & Group CEO; Thomas Husted Vice President Director & COO; Agus D.W. Martowardojo President Commissioner; Garibaldi Thohir Commissioner. AGM also renewed authority for share ownership program issuance and approved a non-pre-emptive capital increase (PMTHMETD) capped at 10% of issued capital; EGM approved Series A/B share conversions.

ca.event: AGM/EGM renews private placement authority (up to 118,436,392,950 Series A shares)
ca.details: The 2023 AGM/EGM approved a new non-pre-emptive capital increase authority of up to 118,436,392,950 new Series A shares (10%), to grow the business and strengthen capital. Partly used in Oct 2023 (17.05bn shares to Bhinneka Holdings, see 2023-10-03).

ca.event: Argor Capital (formerly Go-Ventures, GoTo's CVC arm) launches US$240m Fund 2 with GoTo as LP
ca.details: Go-Ventures, GoTo's corporate venture arm, was rebranded Argor Capital and launched a US$240m second fund. GoTo is an LP alongside sovereign wealth funds, institutions, corporates and family offices; the fund makes investment decisions independently. GoTo's commitment not disclosed (FLAG).

ca.event: SoftBank (SVF GT Subco) and other early backers gradually sell GOTO shares
ca.details: Multiple IDX disclosures in 2023-early 2024 of SoftBank's SVF GT Subco selling GOTO tranches (e.g., ~200m shares May 2023, ~133.9m Jan 2024), alongside GPF. SoftBank nonetheless still held 7.65% as of May 2025 and Sept 2026 lists. Individual tranche details not fully compiled (FLAG).

ca.event: GoTo lays off ~600 more employees (cumulative ~1,900 with the Nov 2022 round)
ca.details: About 600 roles affected across the ecosystem: two GoTo Financial offline merchant teams merged, Mitra Tokopedia partly scaled back, recruitment team restructured, and non-core initiatives cut or delayed. Bisnis reports ~1,900 total layoffs including Nov 2022.

ca.event: 8-month pre-IPO lock-up expires; planned controlled placement abandoned
ca.details: Lock-up on major holders (incl. Alibaba, SoftBank) expired 30 Nov 2022, freeing ~1 trillion shares (>90% of outstanding) for sale. A planned controlled placement to manage the overhang did not proceed (no agreement on price; buyers sought up to 30% discount). Shares fell to record lows.

ca.event: GoTo lays off ~1,300 employees (~12% of workforce)
ca.details: Cost-cutting amid expected prolonged macro uncertainty; cuts across four countries.

ca.event: Term loan facility (November 2022)
ca.details: GoTo entered a bank facility in November 2022; IDR 467bn was outstanding as of June 2025 and was refinanced by the Sept 2025 DBS/UOB facility. Lenders/size of the 2022 facility not verified (FLAG).

ca.event: Planned convertible bond (up to US$1bn, later US$500m) explored, then cancelled
ca.details: Sep 2022 (IFR): GoTo was considering a convertible bond of up to US$1bn, with an indicative 5-year tenor and 3-5% coupon. Apr 2023 (Bloomberg via Bisnis/IBP): the plan, cut to US$500m (~IDR 7.42tn), was dropped after talks with BlackRock, PAG and IFC. Reasons: avoid mixed signals to investors and smaller funding needs (cash ~IDR 29tn said to be enough to reach positive operating cash flow). GoTo did not confirm. Later replaced by the smaller IFC/Franke deal (2023-10-03).

ca.event: GoTo (via GoPay entity DKAB) acquires 100% of PT Kripto Maksima Koin for IDR 124.83bn
ca.details: DKAB (99.99% owned by GoTo) bought 100% of crypto asset trader PT Kripto Maksima Koin (KMK; Bappebti registration dated 28 Jan 2022) from two unaffiliated individuals (50,000 shares) for ~IDR 124.83bn (~US$8.4m). Purpose: business expansion. Divested/deconsolidated in 2024 (see 2024-10).

ca.event: Bank Jago named strategic funding partner for GoPayLater Cicil on Tokopedia
ca.details: Bank Jago is a strategic partner funding GoPayLater Cicil (1-12-month instalments on Tokopedia). Structure (channelling vs joint financing) and volumes not disclosed. GoPayLater is provided by PT Multifinance Anak Bangsa (MAB). No source found for other bank lending or channelling partners (e.g., BNI, Mandiri, BCA) or for any securitisation (GAP).

ca.category: Asset transfer to JV (Electrum) / affiliated transaction
ca.event: GoTo subsidiary PT Rekan Anak Bangsa sells e-motorbike assets to Electrum for IDR 23.6bn
ca.details: RAB sold 251 Gogoro 2 Plus smart scooters, 502 battery kits and trademark assets to PT Energi Kreasi Bersama (Electrum), in which RAB held 50%, for IDR 23.6bn (agreement 29 Jul 2022).

ca.event: AGM approves private placement authority of up to 10% (~118.44bn Series A shares); lapsed unused
ca.details: AGM approved a non-pre-emptive capital increase (PMTHMETD) of up to 10% of issued capital (up to ~118bn Series A shares at IDR 1 par; max dilution 9.09%), valid for one year (POJK rule cited in source). Stated use: working capital for Tokopedia, Dompet Anak Bangsa and/or Multifinance Anak Bangsa. GoTo did not use it (management said in Jun 2023 it had no plan to). In Dec 2022 GoTo told a public expose it was exploring a private placement as the lock-up expired.

ca.event: GoTo lists on IDX Main Board (ticker GOTO) at IDR 338/share
ca.details: 46.7bn Series A shares offered (new shares plus treasury shares for over-allotment). Total raised ~US$1.1bn (IDR 15.8tn): US$954.7m (IDR 13.7tn) offering proceeds + US$146.3m (IDR 2.1tn) from treasury shares sold for over-allotment. Market cap ~US$28bn (IDR 400.3tn) at listing. Day-one close IDR 388 (~+14.8%).

ca.event: IPO prospectus dividend policy: no dividends until accumulated retained earnings are positive
ca.details: GoTo intends to pay dividends only after it has positive accumulated retained earnings (negative at 31 Jul 2021). Payments require AGM approval on the Board of Directors' recommendation, depend on earnings, cash flow and prospects, and may be restricted by financing agreements. No payout ratio was stated. Series A and B shares carry equal dividend rights. GoTo has paid no dividend to date. No source found on any dividend plan after the first quarterly net profit in Q1 2026 (GAP).

ca.event: Electrum, Pertamina, Gogoro and Gesits expand two-wheel EV and battery-swap collaboration
ca.details: Expanded the South Jakarta commercial EV trial to thousands of units in 2022, with Gojek drivers operating them. Electrum is the integrator/developer, Pertamina Patra Niaga provides gas stations for battery swapping, and Gogoro and Gesits provide vehicles and swap technology. No equity or investment amounts disclosed. A Kontan headline says Pertamina Patra Niaga also partnered with Gojek/TBS on battery-swap/charging stations (SPBKLU); details not read (FLAG).

ca.event: Sale of Alfamart stake (~IDR 1.5tn) and Coins.ph divestment
ca.details: GoTo sold its Alfamart (AMRT) stake for ~IDR 1.5tn in late 2022 (share count/price undisclosed). Coins.ph (acquired by Gojek Jan 2019 for US$72m) was divested in 2022 (Wikipedia cites US$200m to Wei Zhou; FLAG - not verified against primary source).

ca.event: Gojek and TBS Energi Utama (TOBA) form 50/50 EV JV Electrum (PT Energi Kreasi Bersama)
ca.details: Announced Nov 2021 with an initial US$10m commitment and potential investment of up to US$1bn over five years (TBS's Pandu Sjahrir). Scope: two-wheel EV manufacturing, battery packs, battery-swap infrastructure and EV financing. PT Energi Kreasi Bersama (EKB) was legalised by the Ministry of Law (AHU) on 9 Dec 2021 with authorised/issued/paid-up capital of IDR 71.75bn. Shareholders: GoTo via PT Rekan Anak Bangsa (RAB) and TOBA via PT Karya Baru TBS. Ownership was 50/50: RAB held 50% (38,875 shares in Jul 2022; 78,500 shares in Nov 2023, with PT Karya Baru TBS holding 78,500). Cikarang factory groundbreaking 23 Jun 2023. In Nov 2023 TOBA committed IDR 300bn from its 2023 capex, and Electrum planned >IDR 1tn of investment (R&D, factory, battery-swap stations). No matching GoTo equity amount was found. Latest: H1 2026 revenue US$9.1m (+184% YoY), segment EBITDA +US$0.5m. GoTo's FY2025 investment in joint ventures was IDR 503.1bn (all JVs). Whether the 50/50 split still holds after 2023 is not verified (FLAG).

ca.event: GoTo raises >US$1.3bn in first close of pre-IPO round
ca.details: Led by Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA); participants included Avanda, Fidelity International, Google, Permodalan Nasional Berhad, Primavera Capital, SeaTown, Temasek, Tencent and Ward Ferry. Media estimated valuation at US$28.5-30bn (GoTo declined to comment).

ca.event: Report that GoTo planned to buy a majority of BFI Finance (BFIN) via tender offer
ca.details: Kontan cited an unnamed source saying GoTo would buy a majority of PT BFI Finance Indonesia Tbk via a tender offer. BFIN's director gave a non-committal response. No GoTo deal followed. A Kontan headline (not read) says a 2022 BFIN tender offer was completed by Trinugraha Capital & Co (48.15%) (FLAG). BFIN reappears in the Jul 2026 Bank Jago merger rumour (existing log).

ca.event: GoTo takes 4.8% stake in Multipolar (MLPL)
ca.details: MLPL's controlling holder PT Inti Anugerah Pratama sold 1.66bn MLPL shares (11.37%). GoTo VP Business Development Stefan Ko said GoTo 'officially owns 4.8%' of MLPL. The article cites a 79.87m-share purchase by GoTo and a transaction value of IDR 805.75bn (meta description). These figures do not reconcile with a 4.8% stake (FLAG). Price per share not disclosed. Not listed among GoTo's listed holdings (ARTO, MPPA, BIRD) in a Dec 2022 Kontan review, so the current status is unknown (FLAG).

ca.event: GoTo buys out foreign minority investors in GoPay to become sole owner
ca.details: Ahead of the IPO, GoTo bought the GoPay stakes held by Facebook, Google, PayPal, Tencent Mobility and Gamvest; the sellers were to reinvest the proceeds in GoTo. Stake size and price are behind a paywall (FLAG). GoPay entities are now ~99.99% owned (e.g., DKAB per 2022-2025 sources).

ca.event: GoTo buys a further 6.74% of MPPA from Multipolar for IDR 355bn; standby buyer in MPPA rights issue
ca.details: PT Aplikasi Karya Anak Bangsa (GoTo) bought 507,142,900 MPPA shares (6.74%) from MLPL at IDR 700/share (IDR 355bn) in a crossing on 4 Oct 2021. Kontan's headline says total ownership rose to 11.5%. GoTo was also named standby buyer in MPPA's Q4 2021 rights issue (up to 1,171,200,788 shares / IDR 890.11bn); the projected stake afterwards was ~5.49-6.20%. Later sources list only 507.14m shares (~6%, unchanged since purchase) at Dec 2022, with an unrealised loss of ~IDR 278bn, and 5.98% before MPPA's Jul 2023 rights issue. Sources do not explain why the 4.76% Pradipa stake is missing from those figures, and GoTo's current MPPA holding is unverified (FLAG).

ca.event: Gojek Thailand sold to AirAsia (all-share deal, ~US$50m)
ca.details: AirAsia SuperApp / AirAsia Digital acquired Gojek's Thailand operations in an all-share transaction reported at ~US$50m; Gojek received an equity stake in AirAsia's digital business. Deal announced ~early July 2021 (Rajah & Tann deal note dated 7 Jul 2021).

ca.event: Gojek and Tokopedia announce merger to form GoTo Group
ca.details: Gojek and Tokopedia announced their merger into GoTo (name also a nod to 'gotong royong'), after Gojek-Grab talks in early 2021 reached an impasse. At formation GoTo cited ~100m monthly active users, >11m merchants and >2m drivers; GoTo Financial set up around the same time.

ca.event: Gojek affiliate PT Pradipa Darpa Bangsa buys 4.76% of Matahari Putra Prima (MPPA, Hypermart)
ca.details: PT Multipolar Tbk (MLPL) sold 896,327,200 MPPA shares (11.9%) on 6 Apr 2021. Buyers: PT Pradipa Darpa Bangsa (Gojek group) 358,530,900 shares (4.76%), Panbridge Investment Ltd 3.33% and Theadmore Capital Ltd 3.81%. Price not disclosed.

ca.category: Strategic equity investment (associate - Bank Jago) / rights issue participation
ca.event: GoPay (DKAB) takes up most of its rights in Bank Jago's ~IDR 7tn rights issue; stake ~21.4%
ca.details: ARTO rights issue (up to 3bn new shares at IDR 2,350) ended 17 Mar 2021; shares outstanding rose from 10,856,250,000 to 13,745,773,441. DKAB took up 560m of its 664.8m rights (~IDR 1.31-1.32tn) and ended with ~2.96bn shares (21.44%). GIC entered with 8.08%. Later holdings: 2,965,745,000 shares (21.4%) at Dec 2022; ~21.4% in an Apr 2026 report (MEI ~29.79%, WTT ~11.68%, GIC ~8.28%, free float ~27%). No evidence found of a second ARTO rights issue in 2022 or of later GoTo purchases or sales of ARTO shares (FLAG). The Kontan source is internally inconsistent on the pre-rights % (22.16% vs 20.48%).

ca.event: Gojek (via GoPay entity PT Dompet Karya Anak Bangsa) raises Bank Jago (ARTO) stake from 4.14% to 22.16%
ca.details: PT Dompet Karya Anak Bangsa (DKAB, the GoPay entity) bought 1,956,600,000 ARTO shares at IDR 1,150 (~IDR 2.25tn), taking its holding from 449.14m shares (4.14%) to ~2.4bn shares (22.16%). Stated purpose: investment and a long-term partnership on financial inclusion (Bank Jago accounts in the Gojek app). Control did not change: PT Metamorfosis Ekosistem Indonesia (MEI) and Wealth Track Technology (WTT) kept a combined 51%. Pre-merger deal, included because the stake is still held (see 2021-03-17).

ca.event: Telkomsel invests in Gojek (US$150m convertible bond 2020; US$300m 2021)
ca.details: Telkomsel (JV of Telkom Indonesia and Singtel) invested US$150m in Gojek convertible bonds in 2020 and US$300m in 2021 (total ~US$450m). Later reported as ~23.72bn GOTO shares (~1.99%) at an average acquisition price of ~IDR 270/share (~IDR 6.40tn). Exact month dates not verified from primary filings (FLAG).

ca.event: Gojek acquires POS/SaaS start-up Moka (~US$130m)
ca.details: Gojek notified KPPU of the Moka acquisition by 9 Apr 2020. Value ~US$130m (~IDR 2tn) per a Bloomberg source; earlier reports said ~US$120m. Stake acquired not stated. Included because Moka is still part of GoTo Financial's merchant business; current legal ownership % not verified from filings (FLAG).

ca.event: Gojek buys ~4.3% stake in taxi operator Blue Bird (BIRD)
ca.details: Gojek bought 108.21m BIRD shares at IDR 3,800 (~IDR 411.15bn) on 13 Feb 2020. At 14 Dec 2022 the stake was worth ~IDR 166.1bn (unrealised loss ~IDR 295bn). Still held: IDX data for holders above 1% at 31 Mar 2026 show GOTO with ~108.20m shares (4.32%). Controlling holder Pusaka Citra Djokosoetono has 28.37%.

ca.event: Gojek acquires fintech firms Kartuku, Midtrans and Mapan
ca.details: Pre-merger Gojek bought three Indonesian fintech companies (Kartuku, Midtrans, Mapan) to build out its payments business. Price not disclosed. Included because Midtrans (PT Midtrans, 99.99% owned, received an IDR 28.5bn intra-group capital injection from GoPay entity PT Dompet Karya Anak Bangsa on 25 May 2022) and Mapan (PT Mapan Global Tech, d/b/a Findaya, >=99% owned, the GoTo Financial entity that bought MAB shares in Apr 2024) are still GoTo Financial subsidiaries. Kartuku's current status not verified (FLAG).

verifiedEvents.title: ADB September outlook links energy and weather shocks to demand risks
verifiedEvents.summary: ADB forecasts developing Asia-Pacific growth of 5.0% in 2026 and 5.1% in 2027; the outlook highlights energy and El Niño risks.
verifiedEvents.implication: Expand sensitivity work for driver costs, merchant pricing and household demand.
verifiedEvents.how: Fuel and food costs can change affordability, supply incentives and credit performance.
verifiedEvents.nextAction: Stress test GoTo scenarios using Indonesia-specific cost and consumer data.

verifiedEvents.implication: Await resolutions and effective dates; no outcome inferred.
verifiedEvents.nextAction: Review subsequent disclosures and update the relevant assumptions.

verifiedEvents.title: Trans Mall and Xurya complete solar rollout across 16 locations
verifiedEvents.summary: Company reports 12.34 MWp installed across 16 retail locations in 14 cities. Trans Retail states annual electricity-cost savings of 8–10%; these are counterparty-reported outcomes.
verifiedEvents.implication: Investment watch: repeat-customer expansion offers a signal of execution and recurring project demand. Request contracted cash flows and capex funding before calculating investment returns.
verifiedEvents.nextAction: Track collections, capacity additions and concentration risk.

verifiedEvents.title: Grab proposes $1.49bn acquisition of 60% of Atome Financial
verifiedEvents.summary: Grab signed for a controlling 60% stake, including $260m of primary capital. Closing is expected by Q3 2027, subject to approvals; it is not completed.
verifiedEvents.implication: A scaled BNPL and cash-lending competitor could increase pressure on GoPay's distribution and underwriting. Assess product overlap and partnership alternatives before assigning a financial impact.
verifiedEvents.how: Atome adds consumer-credit products and a merchant network. Competition could affect acquisition cost, pricing and credit growth; timing depends on closing.
verifiedEvents.nextAction: Track regulatory approval, closing and loan performance; benchmark GoPayLater, GoPay Pinjam and Bank Jago distribution.
verifiedEvents.terms: Remaining 40%: planned about two years after Phase 1, under a performance formula with $2.0bn–$4.5bn equity-value bounds. Future consideration is not a fixed price.

verifiedEvents.title: Grab plans to execute remaining approximately $900m buyback authority
verifiedEvents.summary: Grab intends to use remaining share-repurchase authority over the next 12 months, funded from existing cash. Execution depends on market conditions; the full amount is not guaranteed.
verifiedEvents.implication: Adds a relevant capital-return benchmark for GoTo's board. Compare repurchase value creation with liquidity needs, financing capacity and prospective deal returns.
verifiedEvents.how: Repurchases use cash and can reduce outstanding shares; the effect depends on execution price and competing uses of capital, rather than authorization alone.
verifiedEvents.nextAction: Monitor actual repurchases and reconcile capital returns with acquisition commitments and financial-services funding.

verifiedEvents.title: Bank Jago public expose adds direct lending and wealth strategy context
verifiedEvents.summary: The September presentation outlines direct customer acquisition, direct lending, FX and wealth features alongside ecosystem distribution.
verifiedEvents.implication: Assess commercial synergies with GoTo separately from the associate equity interest.
verifiedEvents.how: Direct distribution and partner channels can alter acquisition cost, deposit mix and concentration.
verifiedEvents.nextAction: Monitor direct versus partner origination, funding mix and channel-level credit performance.
